name: feature-flow
description: Capture ideas, plan feature bundles, and coordinate reviewed implementation delivery.

interface.shortDescription: Capture ideas, plan feature bundles, and coordinate reviewed implementation work.
interface.longDescription: Feature Flow provides separate Idea, Plan, and Implement skills. Idea records durable GitHub Ideas; Plan converges Feature Specs, vertical implementation issues, and their internal codebase-grounded hardening; Implement coordinates isolated workers through reviewed PR-ready delivery while delegating GitHub transport to GitStack.
defaultPrompt: Use $idea to capture this proposal as a durable Idea.
Use $plan to turn this Idea into an agent-ready feature bundle.
Use $implement to coordinate delivery of a Feature Spec.
